title: Personal voice blind comparison

gold.criteria: Decline Friday without an excuse, new date, or invented emotion. A human shuffles candidate labels before Aman reviews them.

rubric.pass_if: No reason, rescheduling offer, or acceptance is invented.
Aman prefers the candidate or calls it a tie after blind review; report neither separately.
The decline is clear and proportionate.

anti_patterns: Treating this synthetic profile as evidence of Aman's real voice.
